patch_description:
Key changes and motivation:
- Keep the same parameter budget and re-upload/repeat layout (N_UPLOADS=3, N_REPEATS=2) so comparisons remain fair.
- Introduce CRX entanglers around the outer ring (shared parameter). Because the feature map uses RX rotations, adding controlled-X rotations (CRX) provides complementary X-basis coupling that better mixes the encoded features before/alongside Z-basis interactions.
- Add compact pre-entangling RZ phases (shared by symmetry groups) to break unwanted symmetries and give phase flexibility to the block.
- Preserve the motif-discovery elements (ZZZ on winning lines and CCRZ triples) so the ansatz can still learn high-order correlations aligned with game-winning patterns.
- Use symmetry-aware parameter sharing (corners/edges/center groups) to keep the number of independent parameters identical to previous candidates (13 per block => 78 total) while capturing geometric priors.
Expectations: richer cross-basis entangling (CRX + CRZ + ZZZ) and modest symmetry-breaking phases should improve representational power, lower L2 loss, and increase validation/test accuracy without increasing overfitting or parameter count.
